name: Android na Imouto
source:
Main character loses his sister and grows hatred towards androids. Two android girls resembling his sister appear before him. What are their intentions?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角失去了妹妹，并对机器人产生了仇恨。两个酷似他妹妹的机器人女孩出现在他面前。他们的意图是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
